name: Child Safe — Parental Control & Device Governance
tagline: Total peace of mind for your child's digital world: Kiosk Mode, weekly quotas, real-time GPS tracking, remote password reset, app suspension/permissions, call/SMS logs, stealth mode, anti-uninstall safeguards, and parent device self-governance.
description:
Manage screen time, block distractions, audit communication logs, enforce fine-grained app permissions, and dispatch remote commands to child devices. Architected on Android Device Policy Manager (Device Owner DPM API) for 100% unbreakable security.

Core Features & Capabilities

📌 Kiosk Mode Launcher

Replace default home screen with approved apps only. Prevents policy bypasses with an offline 4-digit recovery PIN.

⏳ Weekly Screen Time Quotas

Configure custom daily hour/minute allowances for weekdays vs. weekends, with scheduled bedtime lockouts.

📍 Real-Time GPS & Routes

Live position updates and periodic route history logs (5m to 24h interval snapshots) powered by FusedLocation API.

🛡️ 50+ Hardware Restrictions

Block factory reset, Wi-Fi changes, USB file transfer, ADB debugging, camera/microphone toggles, and screenshot captures.

🔑 Remote Password Reset & Reboot

Remotely change child device lock screen PIN/password and dispatch instant encrypted reboot commands from the parent dashboard.

⚙️ App Suspension & Permission Control

Suspend, hide, or uninstall child apps remotely. Fine-tune runtime app permissions (Camera, Microphone, Contacts, Storage) to Allow or Deny.

📞 Call Logs, SMS & Contacts Audit

View child device incoming/outgoing call history, SMS message logs, and contact book details remotely for safety compliance.

🔒 Stealth Mode & Anti-Uninstall

Show or hide the Child Safe app icon on the child device. Gray out and disable system Uninstall buttons, making the app 100% unremovable.

📊 Child App Usage Statistics

Monitor real-time time spent per app, launch frequencies, screen unlocks, and daily usage metrics to encourage healthy digital habits.

🔐 Smart PIN & Biometrics

Rhythm-based typing pattern analysis defense and fingerprint unlock safeguard master parent configurations.

🚀 Zero-Touch QR Provisioning

Provision factory-reset devices as Device Owner via 6-tap encrypted QR code payloads in minutes.

📱 Parent Device Self-Governance

Optionally configure parent device rules to hide, suspend, or uninstall parent apps to avoid digital distractions.

Deep-Dive Capabilities

📌 Kiosk Space & Launcher Pinning

Transform any Android phone or tablet into a dedicated learning device. In Kiosk Mode, the standard launcher, notification panel, recent apps, and system settings are completely locked out. Parents specify exactly which apps are visible on the child’s home screen.

⏳ Weekly Screen Time Quotas & Bedtime Locks

Set strict usage allowances for weekdays vs. weekends with per-day hour and minute pickers and scheduled bedtime lockouts.

📍 Real-Time GPS & Periodic Route Snapshots

Track live location and view periodic route history logs (5m to 24h interval snapshots) powered by Google FusedLocation API.

🔑 Remote Password Reset & Device Reboot

Parents can remotely change the child device lock screen PIN or password at any time. If the device requires a fresh restart, dispatch a remote reboot command directly from the parent dashboard.

⚙️ App Suspension, Hiding & Permission Control

Take full control over installed apps. Parents can suspend apps to freeze execution, hide launcher icons, or uninstall non-approved applications remotely. Manage runtime permissions (Camera, Microphone, Location, Contacts, Storage) to enforce strict safety boundaries.

📞 Communication & Safety Logs Inspector

Stay informed on your child's communication safety. Inspect call logs (incoming, outgoing, missed call durations), view SMS message history, and audit contact book entries remotely.

🔒 Stealth Mode & Anti-Uninstall Safeguards

Toggle Stealth Mode to hide the Child Safe icon on the child device. Under Device Owner policy, system 'Uninstall' and 'Force Stop' buttons are grayed out and disabled, rendering the app completely unremovable without parent authentication.

📊 App Usage Stats & Parent Device Self-Governance

View detailed app usage statistics, daily time spent metrics, and unlock counts for child devices. Parents can also secure the Child Safe app with standard PIN, Smart PIN (keystroke rhythm analysis), or Biometric fingerprint unlock, and optionally configure rules to hide/suspend/uninstall parent device apps.
